about: Catalogue for the readiness engine (processing/src/cascade_lens/readiness.py). Dataset IDs, areas and windows follow the Stage 0 audit, sections 08 to 11. A dataset counts only when a SOURCE.json declaring its ID is on disk.

A1.name: NISAR Pair A and Pair B, prepared

A2.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, study area clip

A4.name: OpenStreetMap context and HOT post-event mapping

B1.name: GPM IMERG V07 rainfall, Late or Final

B2.name: DHM discharge and stage, with station metadata and danger levels

B3.name: Archived rainfall forecasts, as issued
B3.source: ECMWF TIGGE or MARS (terms to verify)

B5.name: Copernicus DEM for the whole Trishuli catchment (R2)

C1.name: Dated landslide inventory with completeness notes
C1.source: BIPAD; NASA GLC/COOLR; NSIDC HMA v2; published inventories

C5.name: Rainfall for thresholds: IMERG plus DHM daily gauges

C7.name: NISAR GUNW repeat series (Track 48 frames 74 and 75, Track 98 frame 16)

E1.name: Field reports or photos for named places

E4.name: Independently mapped landslides for the test period

F10.name: Historical flood events with dates, extents and stage

capabilities.name: F0 Geographic context: terrain, rivers, the mapped 2026 extent
capabilities.decision: Context only: shows where things are, not what will happen

capabilities.name: F2 Rainfall monitoring against a documented threshold
F3 24-hour threshold forecast for the Trishuli main stem

next.model: A lumped conceptual model with a snow routine, forced by IMERG history
next.calibration: Calibration up to 2021 against DHM discharge
next.validation: Chronological validation 2022 to 2024 with POD, FAR and CSI
next.operational: A full monsoon season evaluated with partners

capabilities.decision: Start after data supply, then after validation

capabilities.name: F4 Inundation forecast
capabilities.decision: Not feasible with available data: no hydraulic inputs

capabilities.name: F5 Infrastructure impact of a forecast flood
capabilities.decision: Only after a validated flood output exists

capabilities.name: L0 Terrain and geological context
capabilities.decision: Context only; the terrain screen is experimental and terrain-only

next.model: Logistic regression on terrain, geology and land cover
next.validation: Spatial block cross-validation and a held-out valley (E4)

capabilities.name: L2 Rainfall-trigger monitoring

next.model: Empirical intensity-duration thresholds with an antecedent term
next.validation: 2025 to 2026 held out: POD, FAR, missed events

capabilities.decision: Start after data supply, then after validation

capabilities.decision: Start after data supply, then after validation
